name: Shadows of Doom
label: Quest
description: Shadows of Doom: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.

In truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you had any luck, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. With the shadows destroyed, it can only be a matter of time before the Lich King decides to recall his necropolises and leave us in peace.
